title: VLM Latency Characterization Record
description: Per-inference record emitted by run_vlm_latency_benchmark.sh and consumed by vlm_latency_report.py. Fields unavailable from the runtime are represented as null — they are never inferred or fabricated.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (timestamp-based), shared across all records in one benchmark invocation.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 wall-clock timestamp when this inference record was written.

condition.description: Experiment condition label from the matrix (e.g. A, B, C, D, E).

path.description: Invocation path: 'direct' for native Edge-LLM cold-start invocation, 'ipc' for persistent edge_vlm_server via IPC socket.

lifecycle_semantics.description: Lifecycle phase measured: 'cold_start' for direct (includes per-process init), 'persistent' for ipc (steady-state against running server). Null for records written before this field was introduced.

image_id.description: Stable identifier for the input image (filename stem or content hash prefix).

image_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the input image file used for this inference.

image_width_px.description: Effective image width in pixels after any resize applied before encoding.

image_height_px.description: Effective image height in pixels after any resize applied before encoding.

content_hash.description: Short SHA-256 hex prefix (12 chars) of the image file content, for reproducibility verification. Null if not computed.

prompt_hash.description: Short SHA-256 hex prefix of the exact prompt text used, for reproducibility verification.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens requested from the model.

actual_output_tokens.description: Actual number of output tokens generated. Null if the runtime does not expose this.

finish_reason.description: Finish reason from the native response JSON (e.g. 'eos', 'max-length', 'stop'). Null if not available from the runtime. Responses with finish_reason='max-length' are capped and do not represent natural task completion.

output_text.description: Response text from the native output JSON or IPC client artifact, preserved for reference. Null when unavailable.

output_words.description: Whitespace-delimited word count of output_text from the IPC client artifact. Not a model token count. Null for direct path or when unavailable.

inference_seconds.description: Wall-clock inference time in seconds as reported by edge_vlm_cli (IPC path only). Null for direct path or when not reported.

success.description: True when inference completed without error.

error.description: Error message when success is false; null otherwise.

cold_start_total_ms.description: Shell/process wall time for direct-path invocations in milliseconds (includes process startup, engine load, tokenizer init, and model inference). Null for ipc path. Distinct from model/runtime stage metrics in native_profile_path.

total_latency_ms.description: Measured end-to-end wall-clock latency in milliseconds from inference request to response received. Null on failure. For direct path this equals cold_start_total_ms.

vision_encoder_ms.description: Vision encoder (ViT) average time per run in milliseconds, from the NVIDIA-emitted profile JSON (stages[name=vision_encoder].average_time_per_run_ms). Null if not exposed by the runtime.

prefill_ms.description: Prefill (prompt processing) average time per run in milliseconds, from the NVIDIA-emitted profile JSON (prefill.average_time_per_run_ms). Null if not exposed by the runtime. Never inferred.

ttft_ms.description: Time-to-first-token in milliseconds. Null — the pinned TensorRT Edge-LLM runtime profile does not expose TTFT directly. `prefill_ms` is the closest available proxy but is a distinct metric; the two fields are never conflated.

decode_ms.description: Autoregressive generation total time in milliseconds, from the NVIDIA-emitted profile JSON (generation.total_time_ms). Null if not exposed by the runtime.

decode_tokens_per_sec.description: Generation throughput in tokens per second, from the NVIDIA-emitted profile JSON (generation.tokens_per_second). Null if not available.

average_time_per_token_ms.description: Average time per generated token in milliseconds, from the NVIDIA-emitted profile JSON (generation.average_time_per_token_ms). Null if not exposed by the runtime.

llm_generation_total_gpu_time_ms.description: Total GPU time for LLM generation in milliseconds, from the NVIDIA-emitted profile JSON (llm_generation.total_gpu_time_ms). Null if not exposed by the runtime.

native_response_path.description: Path to the preserved raw llm_inference response JSON artifact. Null for ipc path or when the runtime did not produce output.

native_profile_path.description: Path to the preserved NVIDIA-emitted llm_inference profile JSON artifact (--dumpProfile). Null for ipc path or when profiling was not available.

ipc_result_path.description: Path to the preserved vlm_single_shot_client result JSON artifact in OUTPUT_DIR. Null for direct path or when the IPC call did not produce output.

iteration.description: Zero-based iteration index within this condition/path/image combination.

warmup.description: True when this record is a warmup iteration that should be excluded from aggregate statistics.

tegrastats.description: Optional synchronized tegrastats snapshot captured during this inference.
